text:
### Severity Classification  
**Severity 1 (Critical)**
- Major data breach (personal data exposed, >1,000 customers)
- Ransomware affecting critical systems
- System outage (>4 hours)
- Customer data public exposure
- Regulatory violation (significant)
- Estimated financial impact: >£100,000  
**Severity 2 (High)**
- Suspected data breach (<1,000 customers affected)
- Unauthorized access detected
- System outage (1–4 hours)
- Fraud incident (>£10,000)
- Regulatory concern
- Estimated financial impact: £10,000–£100,000  
**Severity 3 (Medium)**
- Suspected unauthorized access (not confirmed)
- Malware detected (contained)
- System performance issue
- Fraud incident (<£10,000)
- Policy violation
- Estimated financial impact: £1,000–£10,000  
**Severity 4 (Low)**
- Security alert (false positive)
- Policy violation (minor)
- System hiccup (minor impact)
- Incident report (no immediate threat)
- Estimated financial impact: <£1,000

raw_entities.name: Severity 1 (Critical) — >£100,000 impact or >4-hour system outage
raw_entities.description: The highest severity tier characterized by major data breaches affecting over 1,000 customers, ransomware on critical systems, or system outages exceeding 4 hours. It involves significant regulatory violations and an estimated financial impact greater than £100,000.
context: Major data breach (personal data exposed, >1,000 customers)

raw_entities.name: Severity 2 (High) — £10,000–£100,000 impact or 1–4 hour system outage
raw_entities.description: A high severity tier involving suspected data breaches affecting fewer than 1,000 customers, unauthorized access, or system outages between 1 and 4 hours. Financial impact is estimated between £10,000 and £100,000, and may include fraud incidents over £10,000.

raw_entities.name: Severity 3 (Medium) — £1,000–£10,000 impact
raw_entities.description: A medium severity tier covering unconfirmed unauthorized access, contained malware, or system performance issues. It includes fraud incidents under £10,000 and policy violations, with an estimated financial impact between £1,000 and £10,000.

raw_entities.name: Severity 4 (Low) — <£1,000 impact
raw_entities.description: The lowest severity tier for minor incidents such as false positive security alerts, minor policy violations, or system hiccups with minimal impact. The estimated financial impact is less than £1,000.

raw_entities.name: Data Breach
raw_entities.description: An incident involving the exposure of personal customer data. It is classified as Severity 1 if more than 1,000 customers are affected and Severity 2 if fewer than 1,000 are affected.
context: Major data breach (personal data exposed, >1,000 customers)

raw_entities.name: Ransomware
raw_entities.description: A cybersecurity incident where ransomware affects critical systems, automatically triggering a Severity 1 classification.

raw_entities.name: System Outage
raw_entities.description: A failure of system availability. Outages exceeding 4 hours are Severity 1, while those between 1 and 4 hours are Severity 2, and minor hiccups are Severity 4.

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Access
raw_entities.description: Incidents involving unauthorized entry into systems. Confirmed detection is Severity 2, while suspected but unconfirmed access is Severity 3.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Incident
raw_entities.description: Fraud events categorized by financial impact: those over £10,000 are Severity 2, and those under £10,000 are Severity 3.

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Violation
raw_entities.description: Incidents involving breaches of regulatory requirements. Significant violations are Severity 1, while general regulatory concerns are Severity 2.

raw_entities.name: Malware Detection
raw_entities.description: The detection of malicious software. When the malware is contained, it is classified as a Severity 3 incident.

raw_entities.name: Policy Violation
raw_entities.description: Breaches of internal bank policy. General violations are Severity 3, while minor violations are Severity 4.

raw_entities.name: System Performance Issue
raw_entities.description: Issues relating to the speed or efficiency of systems, classified as Severity 3.
